basis: Repository sources only; populated board not inspected

findings.required_action: Measure/identify installed R29, confirm assembly BOM and calibrate INA219.
findings.source_observation: Schematic R29 = 200mOhm / 1W; PCB manufacturer part = SCR1206F1M1. Conflicting source metadata.

findings.required_action: Read real IC marking and UPDI signature before flashing.
findings.source_observation: Schematic+firmware ATtiny3216; PCB supplier part = ATTINY1616-SN (mismatch).

findings.required_action: Confirm actual fuse marking, current/time characteristic and voltage rating.
Define/test independent hardware all-off and safe boot/brownout logic before any motor operation; revise PCB if required.
findings.source_observation: U34/U36/U37/U35 pin19 STBY all directly on 3.3V. There is NO independent RP2040-controlled global TB6612 standby shutdown.

findings.required_action: Measure U6 VIN/3.3V under no-motor KNX-only and USB-only load.
findings.source_observation: PCB USB_VCC -> D6 -> F1 -> D1 -> U6 VIN -> 3.3V. U6 min VIN 4.75V; margin with two Schottkys is unmeasured.

findings.required_action: Qualify source ORing/backfeed, isolation and a protected supply entry design before applying any external 5V.
findings.source_observation: JMP1 links KNX_VCC to R9_2, Q1 selects source on USB_VCC/5V_. JMP1 is NOT an external 5-V input. Source isolation and backfeed have no actual measurement.

findings.required_action: Record KNX extraction/load and worst-case 3.3V supply behavior.
findings.source_observation: STKNX bus-side draw and buck load budget have not been measured with RP2040, LCD, ATtiny and one 3.3V HmIP-VDMOT.

findings.required_action: Specify independent output default-low and watchdog/stop mechanism; qualify on safe bench before connecting an actuator.
findings.source_observation: Controller main.cpp has no motor-specific GPIO initialization or verified boot/brownout all-off sequence.

findings.required_action: Single-motor arbitration and motor-specific reference/current tests remain mandatory (KNX004/005/006).
findings.source_observation: Exactly one R29/INA219 motor-current channel and shared IN_1/IN_2 for all four dual drivers; no per-motor independent measurement.

findings.required_action: Export valid board revision BOM, manufacturing/netlist evidence and actual native ERC/DRC; reconcile with the populated PCB.
findings.source_observation: Only design JSON/PDF exports found; native EasyEDA electrical ERC, PCB DRC, approved assembly BOM and physical PCB-to-design proof absent. Additional similarly named files: [].

limits: Not EasyEDA native ERC, PCB DRC, copper-connectivity proof or BOM approval.
Not proof of physical IC type, shunt value, fuse rating, voltage or motor behavior.
Simulator KNX020/021 lease/AllOff ACK is NOT an electrical shutdown.
Motor output supply remains 3.3V; never apply external 5V to M_VCC.
